core_idea: Full-Stop Office Fixer Heathcliff is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Ammo** + **Pierce Fragility** carry — stack resources, acquire **Ammo — Atelier Logic** for **AL-HV Pulverisation Round**, then rebuild.
playstyle_guide:
- With **Ammo — Atelier Logic**, **Goin' for the Bullseye** flips to **AL-HV Pulverisation Round** — acquire **Ammo — Atelier Logic** first, then commit the payoff skill.
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Goin' for the Bullseye** — **Precision Aim** adds **+10 Poise** at **next turn**; **Spotter** adds **+4 Poise Count** at **On Use**.
- **Goin' for the Bullseye** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- **Haste** raises Speed for next turn — several bonuses here require being faster than the target.
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.
- Manage **Ammo** — multiple skills spend limited ammo on coin flips. Preserve **Ammo** for S1; when reserves are low, skip or pass on weaker S2, S3 so your strongest skill keeps fully empowered coins.

**S1 — Return Fire** (BP 5, CP +3, 3 coins): rolls — low 5, high 14 (Extremely High).
- Gain +2 Poise Count; [On Use] Gain 2 Haste next turn (once per turn)
- Spend 1 Ammo; [On Hit] Gain +1 Poise Count

**S2 — Headshot** (BP 10, CP +12, 1 coin): rolls — low 10, high 22 (Extremely High).
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, deal +10% damage for every 1 Speed difference (max 50%) ; [On Use] Gain 3 Poise and +2 Poise Count ; [On Use] Gain 2 Haste next turn (once per turn)
- Spend 1 Ammo; +30% Damage on Critical Hit; [On Hit] Inflict 1 Pierce Fragility (2 times per turn); [On Crit] Inflict 1 Pierce Fragility next turn (once per turn)

**S3 — Goin' for the Bullseye** (BP 12, CP +14, 1 coin): rolls — low 12, high 26 (Extremely High).
- Spend 1 Ammo; +50% Damage on Critical Hit; [On Crit] At more than 30 Poise Potency, consume up to 10 of Poise Potency over 30 to deal +(Poise Potency consumed x 10)% damage

*↳ Alternate S3 — AL-HV Pulverisation Round* (BP 15, CP +18): rolls — low 15, high 33 (Extremely High).
  - Spend 1 Ammo — Atelier Logic

Combat passive — **Snipe**: Encounter Start: gain 3 Pierce Power Up.
  - When this unit enters the Encounter, gain 1 Ammo — Atelier Logic (once per Encounter).
  - Turn End: If this unit does not have any remaining Ammo of any kind, activate Overwatch Assignment (once per Encounter).

Combat passive — **Precision Aim**: Turn End: Gain 1 Haste next turn for every 10 Poise on self (max 2).
  - Combat Start: If this unit is not set to use any Attack Skills (including E.G.O Skills), apply 3 Poise to 1 ally that has the least Poise….
  - Turn End: If this unit did not use any Attack Skills (including E.G.O Skills, excluding Target Spotted), gain 10 Poise and 1 Pierce Power….

Defense skill — **Counter: Combat Poise**: Turn Start: At 0 Ammo, this Skill activates as 'Taking Cover' instead.
  - [On Use] If [[Full-Stop Office Rep Hong Lu.
